title: The General Prologue, Lines 79–100
subtitle: Yeoman, Prioress — martial to ecclesiastical.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: The Yeoman, the Prioress introduced. Transition from martial to ecclesiastical estates. Vocabulary: pecok arwes (peacock arrows), bracer (arm-guard), gay daggere (fine dagger), yemanly (in yeoman fashion), cloistre (cloister), charitable (full of charity), pitous (compassionate), Eglentyne (her name), coral (coral beads), gauded (fitted with large beads).

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.
